Uninstall

          

            Removes AuraMCP from this machine. On Windows the bundled
            uninstaller runs; on macOS / Linux it opens an alert with the
            manual steps. Per-user data in
            %APPDATA%\com.auramcp.server is kept by default and
            must be deleted manually.
